PR-4 treats that as expected while proving raw unknown relation types are now rejected, skipped, or sent to governed review.

focused_validation.artana_evidence_api_service_checks: passed after final proposal-store compatibility fixes
focused_validation.aggregate_service_checks: passed with captured exit code 0; coverage 86.83% against the 86% floor

summary.verdict_reason: 30/30 cases are invalid because agent extraction did not complete without fallback.

implementation_evidence.llm_schema: LLM relation_type is constrained to canonical relation types or PROPOSE_NEW_RELATION_TYPE.
implementation_evidence.structured_new_type_proposal: New relation proposals must use proposed_relation_type plus new_relation_type_rationale and are skipped by normal candidate creation.
implementation_evidence.resolver_failure: Kernel resolver failure now returns requires_review instead of register_new.
implementation_evidence.candidate_filter: Malformed or legacy raw types that reach resolver decisions are retained only for map_to_existing or typo_correction; review/register decisions are dropped from normal candidates.
implementation_evidence.legacy_preflight: Flat graph gateways without validation no longer silently allow relation writes; successful test gateways expose explicit validation authority.
implementation_evidence.proposal_store_guard: Candidate-claim proposal persistence now normalizes governed relation-type synonyms and rejects raw unknown relation types in both in-memory and SQLAlchemy stores.
implementation_evidence.audit_gate: The relation feasibility audit counts candidate-level raw_unknown_relation_type_count plus inventory-level raw_unknown_relation_type_surface_count and treats surviving raw unknown candidate or surface types as RED-quality issues.
implementation_evidence.boundary_regressions: Post-adversarial regressions cover normal proposal drafts, variant-aware proposal drafts, rejected-relation review items, review-queue conversion, proposal stores, preflight dictionary side effects, and graph claim persistence.

fixes: Graph /claims now rejects unknown relation types before claim persistence.
Variant-aware extraction maps AFFECTS to MODULATES and skips raw EXPLAINS from normal candidate_claim staging.
build_document_extraction_drafts skips raw unknown and PROPOSE_NEW_RELATION_TYPE candidates defensively.
Preflight no longer auto-submits relation-type dictionary proposals as a side effect of raw unknown graph writes.
re_review_fixes: Rejected relation review items canonicalize relation types and skip raw unknown labels before nested proposal-draft creation.
Candidate-claim proposal persistence has a shared relation-type guard for in-memory and SQLAlchemy stores.
Review-queue conversion returns conflict instead of creating a proposal from legacy raw unknown relation payloads.
The relation feasibility audit can score supplied review/proposal/graph/dictionary relation-type inventory surfaces.
Legacy proposal payloads using relation_type, proposed_relation, or SUGGESTS are migrated to governed proposed_claim_type values.
adversarial_review.external_final_re_review_caveat: The strict audit currently populates candidate relation-type inventory surfaces; proposal, graph, and dictionary surfaces are covered by boundary tests until a live agent-path inventory artifact exists.

known_remaining_risk: The strict audit remains RED because no local agent run completed. PR-4 closes tested raw relation-type leakage and adds a relation-type surface inventory contract, but a live agent-path inventory artifact is still required to prove the live LLM path is clean.
